item.title: ENS Mandates Intros 195_193_583A_5A_6A_434
item.description:
Housing Preservation and Development | Procurement | Award | $8.6M | Vendor: Visionaryz Inc In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Housing Preservation and Development awarded Visionaryz Inc $8,621,289 through an intergovernmental purchase to upgrade its systems to comply with six City legislative mandates covering heat sensors, vacant unit inspections, lead paint hazards and false correction certifications.

This project involves enhancing multiple systems across the Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) department to comply with six legislative initiatives (Intros 195-A, 434-A, 5-A, 6A-, 193-A, and 583-A). The project consolidates the business needs of multiple mandates aimed at improving the efficiency and regulatory compliance of HPD's operations. The mandates are related to the Heat Sensor Program, vacant unit inspections, lead-based paint hazard management, and addressing false certifications of violation corrections. This project addresses specific legislative mandates and operational inefficiencies within HPD.

item.title: Gas-Fired Heating Plants & Water Heaters Inst & Rpr - MX
item.description:
Housing Preservation and Development | Procurement | Award | $900K | Vendor: Approved Oil Company of Brooklyn Inc In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Housing Preservation and Development awarded Approved Oil Company of Brooklyn Inc a $900,000 contract, chosen through competitive sealed bids, to install, repair and maintain gas-fired heating plants and water heaters in buildings.

HPD is charged with enforcing New York Citys Building Code and Multiple-Dwelling Law. The proposed contract will facilitate such enforcement with respect to Heat and Hot Water requirements by providing for the necessary installations, repairs and maintenance to Gas-Fired Heating Plants and Water Heaters.
